ops.text: Standing fix for ERR_REQUIRE_ESM in acme-platform packages: set "type": "module" in the package's package.json, import local files with the .js extension, and use import/export instead of require()/module.exports. Applied to scripts/seed-demo (@acme/seed-demo).
Jordan is setting up a new work laptop (Sept 2026); the fresh clone of acme-platform is at ~/code/acme-platform. scripts/seed-demo needs Postgres running and DATABASE_URL set before `pnpm start`.
Standing rule from Jordan: for any large refactor, show a plan first and wait for explicit approval before touching any code.

Planned refactor of apps/api/src/routes/invoices.ts (917 lines): split into routes/invoices/ with index.ts, crud.ts, lifecycle.ts, pdf.ts, export.ts, schemas.ts, service.ts; OpenAPI output must stay byte-identical. Jordan said the plan looks fine but told Claude to hold off (as of 2026-09-24); not started. Coverage is weak for the PDF and export.csv routes (78.4% lines); computeTotals and loadInvoiceWithLines are imported by routes/payments.ts and emails/invoice-sent.tsx.

Gotcha: CI in acme-platform runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, so after adding or changing a dependency you must commit pnpm-lock.yaml too, otherwise the install job fails with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE.

Priya Shah's branch priya/acme-212-redis-sg adds an ingress rule (aws_security_group_rule.redis_from_worker, tcp/6379) letting the worker node security group reach Redis/ElastiCache, plus a variable worker_node_sg_id with no default that every environment must set. Marco needs it for the worker rollout (BullMQ consumers move to a new node group). Claude asked whether to push it to prod; Jordan has not authorized that.
Rule: any change under infra/ needs a review from the platform team and the terraform/plan output pasted into the PR description.
Rule of thumb from Jordan: never deploy to production on Fridays (also no prod release tags on Fridays).

Release tags in acme-platform are calendar-versioned like v2026.09.17 (latest at 2026-09-24); the changelog for the next tag is built from `git log <last tag>..origin/main`. Claude must not create or push a tag until Jordan says go.

To inspect web bundle size, run `ANALYZE=true pnpm --filter web build` (reports in apps/web/.next/analyze/). On 2026-09-24, /dashboard First Load JS was 461 kB (298 kB at last tag); biggest: recharts+d3 312 kB (revenue-chart.tsx), @clerk/nextjs 88 kB, full date-fns locale 71 kB.

The Drizzle ORM schema in apps/api/src/db/schema.ts is the single source of truth for tables; migrations in apps/api/drizzle/ are generated with `pnpm --filter api db:generate`. A nullable invoices.po_number column was added (migration 0042) but is not yet in the zod schemas or invoice DTO.

Gotcha: AWS Load Balancer Controller must be upgraded before the EKS cluster goes to 1.29. On 2026-09-16 staging had ~1h45m of ingress 404s because controller v2.6.2 could not reconcile after the 1.28 to 1.29 upgrade (fixed with v2.8.1). acme-prod still runs controller v2.6.2 (chart 1.6.2) on cluster 1.28; the controller step is still missing from infra/docs/runbooks/eks-upgrade.md.
Plan: acme-prod EKS 1.29 upgrade is pencilled in for 2026-10-06, owner Priya Shah. The AWS Load Balancer Controller upgrade from v2.6.2 must happen first.

Open issue as of 2026-09-24: a customer reported the acme CLI crashes on launch after updating; Claude could not reproduce with a fresh 2.4.1 build from main (--version, whoami, invoices list work). Waiting on support for the full error text, OS and runtime details. Jordan wants a patch release (2.4.2 via packages/cli/package.json) once understood.
The login page is apps/web/app/login/page.tsx and renders Clerk's SignIn component (path routing on /login, redirects to /dashboard).

The acme CLI (packages/cli) must support Node 18 and later: no newer APIs without a fallback (tsup target is node18). Known violation found 2026-09-24: Array.prototype.toSorted (Node 20+) in src/commands/invoices-export.ts:27 needs a fallback; also avoid import.meta.dirname/filename.
To switch kubectl context to prod: `aws eks update-kubeconfig --name acme-prod --region us-east-1`.
Rule: ask Jordan before adding a new dependency (npm/pnpm package).
Commit message convention: imperative mood subject (e.g. "Add po_number column to invoices") with a short body explaining why.

Postgres pool max is 10 connections per pod for the API (apps/api/src/db/client.ts), agreed by Jordan and Priya after staging 'too many connections'. Scale pods, not the pool. Reviewer note: pool size times max pods must stay under the PgBouncer limit.

The worker exposes Prometheus metrics on port 9464 at /metrics. The helm chart infra/helm/worker has a metrics values block, a named metrics Service port and a ServiceMonitor (30s) so Grafana scrapes it (branch acme-214-worker-servicemonitor).

API CSV export (apps/api/src/lib/csv.ts) quotes fields containing commas, quotes or newlines per RFC 4180 and uses CRLF line endings (Jordan chose to keep CRLF); download filename is invoices-<org slug>.csv. This changes the customer-facing file, so mention it in PR descriptions (branch acme-211-csv-export).

Local setup for acme-platform: clone acme/acme-platform, `nvm use`, `pnpm install`, `docker compose up -d db redis` (compose also defines mailpit), `pnpm --filter api db:migrate` once, then `pnpm dev` at the root (turbo run dev) starts web, api (port 4000) and worker. Local env variables come from Lena. Used for onboarding a contractor starting 2026-09-25.

Preference: keep diffs small, one concern per pull request; unrelated commits get split into their own branches cut from origin/main (e.g. acme-211-csv-export, acme-213-api-pool-max, acme-214-worker-servicemonitor).

New authenticated pages in apps/web go under apps/web/app/(dashboard)/ (gets sidebar/header layout, assumes signed-in user); public pages go in app/(marketing). Route group names are not in the URL. Lena wants a /reports page at app/(dashboard)/reports/page.tsx; Jordan has half-finished edits there in the working tree.

Gotcha: updating all apps/web deps to latest (acme-216-web-deps-latest) broke things: next-intl 4.1.0, recharts 3.0.0, tailwind-merge 3.0.1 and lucide-react 1.0.2 are major bumps causing 3 type errors and 13 test failures (Trash2 renamed TrashIcon, tooltip API, provider setup). Minor/patch bumps (@clerk/nextjs 6.9.6, zod 3.23.9, react-query 5.62.2) are fine; deps-bot PRs #1426/#1427 overlap.

billing-sync (services/worker/src/jobs/billing-sync.ts, every 15 min) can delay Stripe invoices 30+ minutes: it filters created >= lastRunAt, so drafts finalized later are skipped, and lastRunAt is set at run end rather than start. Suggested fix is event-based sync (invoice.finalized/paid) or recording start time plus overlap. It is billing code, so wait for Jordan's review before changing it. Not confirmed as the cause for finance's flagged invoices.

Web reads the API base URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL (apps/web/lib/api-client.ts), falling back to http://localhost:4000. On Vercel the variable exists only for Production, not Preview, so staging (a preview environment) calls localhost:4000; fix is to add it for Preview and redeploy (Jordan is sorting with Priya). reports/actions.ts uses server-side API_URL, a different variable.
